command:
set -u
test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opsadmin-ssh-check.XXXXXX) || exit 1
trusted_key="$test_dir/trusted"
untrusted_key="$test_dir/untrusted"
known_hosts="$test_dir/known_hosts"
cleanup() {
  sed -i '/ infraset-temporary-verification$/d' /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f "$trusted_key" "$trusted_key.pub" "$untrusted_key" "$untrusted_key.pub" "$known_hosts"
  rmdir "$test_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C infraset-temporary-verification -f "$trusted_key" || exit 1
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C infraset-untrusted-verification -f "$untrusted_key" || exit 1
cat "$trusted_key.pub" >> /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf '%s\n' '--- authorized temporary key login ---'
ssh -i "$trusted_key" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey -o PasswordAuthentication=[REDACTED] -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -o ConnectTimeout=10 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'printf "login_user="; id -un; printf "uid="; id -u; printf "home="; pwd'
trusted_rc=$?
printf 'authorized_login_exit=%s\n' "$trusted_rc"
printf '%s\n' '--- unauthorized key rejection ---'
reject_output=$(ssh -i "$untrusted_key" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey,password,keyboard-interactive -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -o ConnectTimeout=10 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'true' 2>&1)
reject_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$reject_output" | tail -n 3
printf 'unauthorized_login_exit=%s\n' "$reject_rc"
[ "$trusted_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$reject_rc" -ne 0 ]
